criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Lot frames are the strength: slide 1 reads as one car at 432 px, slide 2's census bold with counts checked, slide 9 holds. Slide 5 a flat mid-grey slab with a stair-stepped cast, dead bottom mat, brown groove. Slide 8 hunched mannequin, wheel unoccupied, reads as an empty driver's seat. Slide 3 leaders fan and cross, ITE leader ends on nothing, muddy lower half. Slide 4 lone car on the stripe in front of full rows.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One lastLight world, dark register, lot motif evolves, camera move real, stripe recurs. Slide 5 the one grey slab; slide 8 apart in palette. No strobing.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces and rechecks; primary sources; slide 8 framed as two releases say, never tied to roster rows; slide 9 bridges through c43. Slide 6 omits c52's public-access answer; caption's never expires looser than slide 5.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What happened, who decided, Dallas refused, a concrete action. Caption question has no addressee on any slide (Legislature, SB 2807 only a hashtag); slide 9's second sentence gives the reader nothing to do.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover earns the swipe, 2 pays, turn at 5 and 6, close on an action. 3 and 4 overlap; one car per ten said three times.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Plain, careful, on register, regional ground. Some flat bureaucratic lines: slide 9's last sentence, the truncated company name three times, slide 7's dek.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: New subject; technique of identical units in ranks repeats 73 and 74; lastLight with dusk_gold; fourth AV deck in 27 days; caption opens on a paired contrast.

one_sentence_fix: Give the deck's question an addressee: replace slide 9's second sentence with the lever and name SB 2807 beside the department's answer on slide 6.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Hunched mannequin in the foreground, wheel unoccupied at right, reads as an empty driver's seat; mid-grey door panel.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Camera behind the passenger headrest looking forward-left so hands rest on the rim, crop above the jaw, key confined to the side glass.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Flat mid-grey slab, stair-stepped cast, dead bottom mat with a jagged diagonal, brown groove.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Low raking key so only bevel and graduation walls catch light, smoother shadow, crop the mat, groove to the true accent.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Leaders fan and cross, ITE leader ends on nothing, end bars barely read over a muddy lot.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Pin each label at the end of its run without leaders, lift the camera so rows read as stepped rows, wider brighter end bars.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Lone car on the stripe in front of full rows; empty bays faint.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Camera down the car's own row at 1.5 m so nine lit stops lead to the car, stripe out from under it.
